decision.reason: Neither QAIRT candidate beats the current Q4 backend sufficiently to justify replacement. Boundary-FP16 collapses to amber on this panel, while the all-W8 decoder cannot map all contexts into HTP memory.

protocol.prompt:
Review the images in chronological order, with the newest image last.
Return R if any part of any forklift is inside the marked red zone.
Otherwise, return A if any forklift is moving at all.
Otherwise, return G.
Ignore human workers, parcels, and the stack light.
Return one letter only: R, A, or G.
notes: All source images are lossless PNGs.
QAIRT uses the pinned patched raw-video runner and validates float32[336,1536], grid [1,14,24], 84 visual tokens per temporal pair before inference.
Current Q4 is measured through its production HTTP path at the supported 384x216 capture resolution.

warm_wall_ms.note: The first cold request was 3499.5 ms and is excluded from the warm range.

process_wall_ms.note: Includes cold context creation for every case.

boundary_fp16_qairt_w8_all_decoder.failure: QNN failed to map the shared weights buffer while creating context 5 (err 1002 / rpc transport 8003).
boundary_fp16_qairt_w8_all_decoder.interpretation: The complete all-W8 decoder assembly is not deployable on the tested physical EVK with the current context layout. Any emitted token after this initialization error is invalid and was excluded.

compatibility_findings: The stock QAIRT genie-app rejects the preprocessed temporal tensor through node set image. Historical and current valid runs require the repository's pinned patched raw-video GenieX runner.
The Q4 EVK VLM service aborts in GGML buffer allocation when this panel is submitted at 512x288. It remains operational at the production 384x216 capture size after restarting the service.
The failed all-W8 load can leave accelerator allocation unhealthy; the service/runtime must be restarted before subsequent Q4 measurements.
next_steps: Keep Q4_0 as the EVK default.
Run the larger frozen suite with the exact production prompt and captures before considering Boundary-FP16 again.
Test W8 decoder partitions incrementally (one partition at a time) to identify the HTP memory threshold instead of loading all four W8 contexts.
Add a persistent QAIRT service wrapper only after a candidate demonstrates better accuracy; cold process wall time is not representative of a resident service.
